name: 01851 · Lowell, MA
findings: ZIP 01851 (Lowell) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01851 (Lowell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01851 (Lowell) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).
